predecessors.name: Western Turkic Khaganate (Western Göktürks)
predecessors.text: the Pontic steppe, where the Onogur Bulgars were clients of Tong Yabghu

predecessors.name: Avar Khaganate
predecessors.text: Kubrat 'quickly managed to overthrow Avar domination'

successors.name: Khazar Khaganate (Khazaria)
successors.text: the Pontic steppe between the Don and the Dnieper, the Kuban and the Crimea

successors.name: First Bulgarian Empire
successors.text: Asparukh's horde between the Dniester and the Danube delta

successors.name: Volga Bulgaria
successors.text: the Volga-Kama confluence, where Kotrag and Batbayan's people went

ledger.x: 633: Kubrat's Great Bulgaria rises on the Pontic steppe.
656: Great Bulgaria expands west into Avar land.

wars.name: Kubrat's revolt against the Avars
wars.outcome: Kubrat united the Onogur, Kutrigur and Utigur Bulgars 'between 630 and 635' and 'quickly managed to overthrow Avar domination'.

wars.name: Khazar conquest of Old Great Bulgaria
wars.outcome: The state 'disintegrated under Khazar attack in 668'; Batbayan became a Khazar subject, Kotrag went up the Volga, Asparukh to the Danube.

certainty.note: Steppe frontiers with no line on either page; the western edge towards the Avars (656) and the Dniester are approximate.
